name: Mental

features.name: Fire Frames
features.description: Fire frames transform symbols into wilds, multipliers or "Autopsy" symbols that boost other symbols.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Increasing multiplier wilds across a growing grid.

review:
One of Nolimit's most notorious games: a disturbing asylum theme, layered modifiers and a 66,666x max. Fire Frames are where the action starts, and the free spins can stack modifiers on top of each other.

The base game is often quiet, and the bonus either fizzles or explodes depending on how the multipliers stack. It's exactly the kind of game to learn in demo first – the feature interactions take a few bonuses to understand. Very high volatility, 96.08% RTP.
cons: Disturbing theme is not for everyone
